text:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: spike of GPU OOMs observed in serving-cluster us-west-2, pods restarting (prefill path). Auto-page oncall.
jamie: Ack, I'm on it. Which pool and model variant?
maria: Seeing repeated prefill OOMs on model-x-8k, pods in pool=gpu-highmem-1. Restart count +3 in last 5m. Logs:
```
[2026-03-17T01:12:03Z] PREFILL OOM: allocation failed 2.1GiB requested, 1.9GiB available
[2026-03-17T01:12:03Z] containerd: killing process 2345 (llm_server) due to OOM
[2026-03-17T01:12:05Z] kubelet: Back-off restarting failed container
```
maria: Example pod: gpu-highmem-1/model-x-8k-7f9b6. Kernel shows CUDA out-of-memory errors for large-context prefill. Prefill sizes hitting ~220k tokens due to concatenated user history + doc attachments.
leo: Immediate mitigations: 1) throttle max-prefill-tokens per-request to 32k via ingress policy, 2) enable prefix trimming for heavy requests, 3) route overflow to model-x-4k (lower mem) or CPU-fallback pool. We can also temporarily increase per-node GPU memory by draining noisy spot jobs.
jamie: Do the throttle + routing now. Maria, prepare a short customer-impact note.
maria: Drafting. "We are investigating increased errors for very long-context requests to model-x-8k affecting some inference requests in us-west-2. Temporary mitigation: we are routing traffic to smaller model variants and throttling very large requests. No data loss."
leo: Running commands now:
```
# throttle via envoy rate-limit header
kubectl -n infra exec -it ingress-ctrl -- envoyctl set-rate-limit route /v1/generate max_prefill_tokens=32000
# route overflow
redwood route update --selector pool=gpu-highmem-1 --overflow-target=pool=gpu-medium-1 --filter "prefill_tokens>32000"
# cordon node with repeated restarts
kubectl cordon ip-192-168-10-44
kubectl drain ip-192-168-10-44 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```
leo: Cordoned ip-192-168-10-44 (2 restarts in 6m). Draining; pods rescheduled to new nodes with lower memory pressure.
jamie: Good. SRE-debra, can you watch for node flaps and NVidia driver resets? If we see driver resets, we'll swap to coldmodel fallback.
sre-debra: Watching. I see one node report `NVRM: GPU fell off the bus` at 01:11:58 — possible hardware glitch exacerbated by long prefill. Will mark for hardware triage if it repeats.
maria: Sending quick customer update to status page and to impacted customers: "We’re mitigating OOMs caused by very large context prefill on model-x-8k. Traffic is being routed to smaller model variants and throttled. We’ll post updates every 15 minutes." /cc @support
jamie: Also enable temporary autoscale +1 for gpu-medium-1 to absorb load spike.
leo: Done: scaled gpu-medium-1 from 6->8 nodes.
maria: After routing+throttle, OOMs dropped: restart events down to 0 in last 5m for targeted pods. Monitoring for 30m.
jamie: Keep an eye on error budget for hosted customers. If errors persist, prepare a rollback to model-x-quantized-8k or enable coldmodel fallback. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Incident acknowledged, severity P2. Paging suppressed for repeated alerts while mitigation active.
